info.title: Nutrient Document Converter Universal API
info.description: Convert, generate, OCR, watermark, secure, archive, and render documents with Nutrient DWS Processor APIs.

get.description: Converts Markdown to PDF in Nutrient.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: markdown
parameters.description: Markdown content to convert into a PDF.

schema.description: Markdown content to convert into a PDF.
schema.default: # Hello from Nutrient\n\nThis PDF was generated from Markdown.

parameters.name: template
parameters.description: Optional built-in template such as built-in:corporate.

schema.description: Optional built-in template such as built-in:corporate.

parameters.name: css
parameters.description: Optional CSS overrides for the PDF output.

schema.description: Optional CSS overrides for the PDF output.
